rules.title: Metagaming
rules.description: Using external stream or discord info in-game.

rules.title: Value of Life
rules.description: You must value your life under gunpoint.
rules.example: Running away while a gun is held to your head.

rules.title: Deep Dive Consent
rules.description: Brain-wiping another character requires OOC consent.
rules.example: Permanently deleting a player character's memories without asking.

rules.title: RDM (Random Deathmatch)
rules.description: Matar o atacar a un jugador sin un motivo de rol previo o válido.
rules.example: Dispararle a alguien en la calle simplemente porque pasó caminando.

rules.title: VDM (Vehicle Deathmatch)
rules.description: Utilizar un vehículo como un arma para atropellar o dañar de forma intencional.
rules.example: Embestir repetidamente a peatones en zonas seguras sin rol previo.
